verdict.rationale: pnpm is a drop-in replacement for npm that installs from the same npm registry ecosystem, giving developers access to virtually the entire npm package registry without migration or rewrites; community reports confirm large real-world projects (20+ package monorepos, Electron apps, etc.) installing arbitrary npm dependencies successfully via pnpm. missing for 10: explicit first-party statements about registry size/maintenance or support for alternate registries beyond npm compatibility.
